Flow.description:
Runs CAP Successor Screens by calling CAP Successor subflow and updating appropriate fields (e.g. At Risk Score, Comments/Reject Reason, Override Date, CAP User Feedback fields) across Account, IMGA Risk Assessment, At Risk KPI, and CAP State, CAP Level.
*vA5 (Comments/Reject Reason/User Feedback 5) currently maps to Flow State and IMGA Risk Assessment OR At Risk KPI records. *Fault screens no longer show previous button. *Element/variable naming and description enhancements.
Flow.label: Run Successor Display
